# Check for packages and install them if not already installed

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
# List all packages needed for this notebook
required_packages <- c("httr", "jsonlite", "dplyr", "DBI", "RSQLite")

# Check if each one is installed, and install it if missing
for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}
# Confirm
cat("All packages loaded successfully!\n")
```

## Define a simple FUNCTION to get Census field lookup data
``` {R Define function func_get_fields}
func_get_fields <- function(url) {
  resp <- httr::GET(url)
  if (resp$status_code != 200) {
    stop(paste("Request failed with status", resp$status_code))
  }
  
  vars <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr::content(resp, as = "text"), simplifyVector = FALSE)$variables
  
  df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(vars), function(nm) {
    row <- vars[[nm]]
    # Keep only the relevant fields
    label <- if (!is.null(row$label)) row$label else NA
    concept <- if (!is.null(row$concept)) row$concept else NA
    data.frame(
      name = nm,
      label = label,
      concept = concept,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
  
  rownames(df) <- NULL
  return(df)
}

```

## Setup URLs for variable lookup pull 

``` {R Setup URLs to pull lookups for human-readable variable names}
# Detailed variable lookup URLs (converted from Python)
census_fields_url1 <- paste0(census_combined_url, "/variables.json")        # detailed variable lookup
census_fields_url2 <- paste0(census_combined_url, "/subject/variables.json")# subject variable lookup with stats
census_fields_url3 <- paste0(decennial_combined_url, "/variables.json")     # decennial variables lookup

# Print full URLs so you can test them in a browser if desired
cat("census_fields_url1:\n", census_fields_url1, "\n\n")
cat("census_fields_url2:\n", census_fields_url2, "\n\n")
cat("census_fields_url3:\n", census_fields_url3, "\n\n")
```

## Get human readable variable names from API
```{R get variable names from API}

fields_df1 <- func_get_fields(census_fields_url1)
fields_df2 <- func_get_fields(census_fields_url2)
fields_df3 <- func_get_fields(census_fields_url3)

# Preview the first few rows of each
cat("fields_df1 preview:\n")
print(head(fields_df1))
cat("\nfields_df2 preview:\n")
print(head(fields_df2))
cat("\nfields_df3 preview:\n")
print(head(fields_df3))
```


## Combine the variable lookups into one big lookup table

```{R combine variable lookups}

# Combine safely even if columns differ

fields_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(fields_df1, fields_df2, fields_df3)

cat("Fields (variables) data have been combined safely.\n")
cat("Total rows:", nrow(fields_df), "\n")

# Preview

head(fields_df)
```

``` {R save variable lookup list to CSV}

# Create table name for variables
fields_table_name <- "census_variables"

# Build the full output path for the fields CSV
fields_csv_path <- file.path(output_folder_path, paste0(fields_table_name, ".csv"))
cat("Fields CSV path:", fields_csv_path, "\n")

# Write the combined fields data frame to CSV
write.csv(fields_df, fields_csv_path, row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

cat("CSV file created successfully:", fields_csv_path, "\n")
```

``` {R save variable lookup list to SQLite database}
# Define the database path
sqlite_path <- file.path(output_folder_path, "census_variables.sqlite")

# Connect to (or create) the SQLite database
conn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), sqlite_path)

# Write the table (overwrite if it exists)
dbWriteTable(conn, "census_variables", fields_df, overwrite = TRUE)

# Optionally list tables to confirm
cat("Tables in database:\n")
print(dbListTables(conn))

# Disconnect
dbDisconnect(conn)

cat("SQLite database created successfully:", sqlite_path, "\n")
```
